_comment: the authoritative Feature_Catalog. Each language's commons server declares the
supported/unsupported half of every feature here in its own feature-config.json;
the union must equal this catalog. A feature is a named capability whose support
may differ by target implementation or generation; it is not a test category, and
universal baseline behavior is not gated. Only capabilities that (a) vary across a
current target or (b) are a genuine independent unit a future native server may not
yet implement are listed here, and each has at least one gated test.
